generation_policy: Each RPC response is a fresh ephemeral CLI call with the complete public conversation. Direct CLI tools are forbidden; public JSON RPC tools are actually executed by the runner. No model or prompt search after freeze. Provider routing, weights, cache and sampling are inherited and not independently attested. No cell is rerun. A terminal cell failure with confirmed process cleanup does not replace or cancel other preregistered cells. Uncertain cleanup stops the experiment. Model names are requested selectors; actual provider routing is not independently attested.
hidden_policy: Hidden cases and independent oracle outputs never enter any model request or public response. Hidden execution happens once, after final public acceptance, and is terminal even on failure. This is a task-information boundary, not a claim of OS hermeticity against malicious generated code.
human_review: No human answer edits. Human review time is unknown. Retain actual transport/compiler/check/native wall time and all five usage fields; no human-cost or full-cost improvement claim is allowed.
implementation_freedom: Complete replacements may change implementation while preserving each maintenance contract and selected resource API. Initial code is public task input; author reference repairs and hidden cases remain outside every prompt.

resource_task_admission: buffer_resize HIA requires actual VM allocate/store/load/drop with new n=x%23+1, index=y%n, byte=(x XOR y)%256 plus zero live owners/loans on all public/hidden cases. Rust uses a new independently bound safe Vec wrapper with the same new contract and explicit-release observations. This is selected API evidence, not whole-process allocator or instruction evidence.
study_kind: Prospective paired authored maintenance pilot; distinct from the frozen public-tools pilot and actual GSL migration evidence.
success_gate: All 12 preregistered cells attempted on frozen source/tools; complete request usage; native outputs match every terminal hidden oracle. Compute the descriptive HIA gate separately within each requested model: no fewer successes, strictly fewer charged tokens and total cell wall time, no more failed public checks. Do not pool model tiers. Missing human review cost prevents a full-cost or human-cost advantage claim.
task_order: Listed task order; reverse model order on odd tasks; reverse language order when task_index+stable_model_index is odd. stable_model_index is the index in the registered models array, independent of iteration order.
task_provenance: Three new authored maintenance contracts with supplied initial programs, independent mathematical oracles, public cases and terminal hidden cases. Positive repairs and unchanged/incorrect/signature controls are author controls only, never model successes. This study is not representative sampling of C/C++ library upgrades.
token_accounting: All five provider fields retained. Cached input is a subset, not added twice. Conservative charged tokens = input + output + reasoning output; provider overlap is not claimed exact. Limits are checked after execution, not pretended hard pre-generation caps. Unknown or exceeded usage ends the cell and retains costs.
transport_provenance: Reuse tools/hia_agent_codex_transport.py unchanged, including its original frozen hia_agent_public_tools/PROTOCOL.json transport caps. The three caps here must match that original protocol; both files are bound in the new source inventory.
